AWS_REGION.description: AWS region whose Inspector v2 endpoint should be queried (Inspector v2 is regional, e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-2). Passed as boto3 client's region_name; AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is used as a fallback if AWS_REGION isn't set as an arg.

INSPECTOR_RESOURCE_TYPE.description: Optional resource-type scope filter (AWS_EC2_INSTANCE | AWS_ECR_CONTAINER_IMAGE | AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION). Short aliases accepted (ec2 | ecr | lambda). Forwarded as filterCriteria.resourceType. Blank queries every resource type the IAM principal can read.

INSPECTOR_SEVERITIES.description: Optional CSV of Inspector v2 severities (INFORMATIONAL | LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL). Faraday-style synonyms (info | low | medium | high | critical) accepted. Forwarded as one filterCriteria.severity EQUALS entry per token. Blank returns every severity.

name: amazon_inspector
title: Amazon Inspector v2
description: AWS Inspector v2 (Amazon Inspector) vendor-native CSPM importer. Pulls security findings from AWS Inspector v2 via the canonical boto3 inspector2.list_findings API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Inspector v2 covers EC2 instances (PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY + NETWORK_REACHABILITY), ECR container images (PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY), and Lambda functions (PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY + CODE_VULNERABILITY). Each affected AWS resource becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 ip; EC2 instances surface the public/private IPv4 address from resource.details.awsEc2Instance when present); per-resource findings attach as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per Inspector findingArn with [CNAPP] engine prefix. Severity is normalised from Inspector's CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFORMATIONAL/UNTRIAGED enum with CVSS v3/v2 base-score bucketing as a fallback when only a numeric inspectorScore or packageVulnerabilityDetails.cvss[].baseScore is given. Status mapped from finding.status (ACTIVE → open, CLOSED → closed, SUPPRESSED → risk-accepted). CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from packageVulnerabilityDetails.vulnerabilityId + relatedVulnerabilities + free-form title / description token-scan. Refs include CWE-* from codeVulnerabilityDetails.cwes, Inspector-Rule / Inspector-Detector / Inspector-Vuln pivots, sourceUrl + referenceUrls + remediation.recommendation.Url. Resolution is built from remediation.recommendation.text (Inspector's canonical guidance) with a vulnerablePackages fixed_in_version fallback like 'Upgrade pkg to ver.'. Auth: AWS Inspector v2 uses the standard AWS SigV4 credential chain. A service account ('IAM principal') with the inspector2:ListFindings permission is required, with credentials exposed as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (+ optional AWS_SESSION_TOKEN for STS-vended session credentials). AWS_REGION pins the regional Inspector endpoint. Tags: [amazon_inspector, cnapp, cloud-native-posture].
